name: Look Up
tagline: Night-sky alerts for your home, only when a pass is worth it
description: Keeps watch on what is passing over your address and messages you only when stepping outside is genuinely worthwhile: space station flyovers, Starlink trains, bright planet viewing and active meteor windows. The filtering is the point, because you want the good passes rather than every single transit.
author: ChefMcMakin
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
